Use this template for general questions, documentation gaps, or other feedback that is not a reproducible bug or feature request. For general discussion, you can also visit [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/FABRICADO08/Budget-Tracker/discussions).

> **Privacy and security:** Use fictional examples only. Never post financial records, account details, passwords, tokens, or personal identifiers. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/FABRICADO08/Budget-Tracker/security/advisories/new).

## What do you need help with?
Describe your question or the issue you want to raise.

Include the feature or workflow involved.

## What have you tried?
List the steps you took and any safe error messages you received.

## What outcome did you expect?
Describe what you thought would happen or what information would answer your question.
